reviews.title: This is a rip off!
reviews.text: Never received the subscription I paid for. Contacted support and just keep receiving the same prerecorded message that doesn’t resolve the issue.

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: This is one of the most useless apps I’ve ever used as the content is all made from AI that you practically can get from Gemini. I did not mean to sign up for them. I clicked on an Instagram ad while they charged me. there is no Easy Way to cancel straight from the app so you have to reach out to the Customer Care. Who will try their best to not return your money and send you the terms and conditions under which also cancellation is allowed if you’re in California.Beware !!!!

reviews.title: INTERESTING INFORMATION
reviews.text: Provides information in an easy format..

reviews.title: Pay to use
reviews.text: Makes you take a long quiz, only tells you afterwards it’s entirely behind a pay wall

reviews.title: Great service and product
reviews.text: I had an initial problem signing in and got immediate help through the chat. I find the lessons to be at exactly the right level for me adding information that I didn’t already have.

reviews.title: Unauthorized Charges
reviews.text: I'd give them 0 stars if I could. They charged me twice for something I didn't pay for and would only give me 50% back. Steer clear.

reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: Downloaded, put in my cc information, then when the app opened it kept asking for my cc information again. I looked at my cc and it was changed. I contacted customer support and said the app wasn’t working. Took three days of going back and forth with customer support before they finally returned my money due to not being able to access the app. They tried to refund me 50% due to having a no refund policy. I said I would just go through my cc company and write a review and then they refunded me. Looks like a scam to me.

reviews.title: High Price for Education
reviews.text: I like this app but the price is too high and not everyone can afford that. I know this app is different than Khan Academy but they offer way many more classes and questions for free. I don’t seem to understand why education had to be expensive, would love for a free version of this even if it’s like a lesson per day for free or something everyone can access. Thank you!

reviews.title: My growth
reviews.text: I’m disappointed about the class I’m supposed to be learning about speaking skills and confidence this is not what I ordered!

reviews.title: Understanding bones & muscles
reviews.text: This is exciting to learn & grow with open vivid images in action.

reviews.title: Total dupe
reviews.text:
I can’t believe someone wasted their energy to create this app and mislead people into spending their money.
I was hoping to find an app to help me be a more dynamic speaker — instead I opened a lesson that suggested I stand taller and walk slowly when entering a room…..  Going to look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Anatomy
reviews.text: Great information. I’m preparing for an exam MBLEX and have ADD this app helps me stay focused and understand visuals and listen to explanations

reviews.title: Customer Support
reviews.text: Just a bunch of chat bots which did nothing to address my technical glitch issue despite my asking the same question time and time again. And not once did they ever repeat my question (which I asked them to do)in order to prove they actually understood my question. So if customer service is important to you as a customer, I recommend you find another micro learning app. ☹️

reviews.title: Important body functions
reviews.text: A student should have the choice to correct on his own a first wrong answer if given the choice. This option is not given.  Besides this detail, this short course is a good incentive for a better familiarity with one’s body.

reviews.title: Great educational app
reviews.text: Good app and great customer service.

reviews.title: AI Slop
reviews.text: The videos, audio, and lessons are complete AI slop, like straight from chat's hiney.

reviews.title: Learning is more fun than unlearning
reviews.text: I was told I had to learn things that didn’t interest me. Now, I get to unlearn those and choose from a buffet of snacks on the My Growth app. My insatiable curiosity is finally satisfied. 🤓👍

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Great visual representation

reviews.title: Great customer support
reviews.text: I accidentally signed up for an additional plan, and the support team was very quick and gave me a gracious response and refund.   AND from what I’ve seen of the app it was beautiful and informative graphics.  Text supports the learning.

reviews.title: Doesn't work
reviews.text: Every time I try to open lesson 1 it asks me to subscribe. If there's no way to even do one lesson without subscribing, it's not worth my time. After I complete the first lesson is when I decide whether to subscribe for more, not before.

reviews.title: Excellent learning app
reviews.text: This is an excellent app to use for quick, interesting, and easy to understand lessons.  The nerd in me appreciates the end of lesson quizzes that can be taken over if desired.  The customer service is swift to respond and very helpful.  I’m giving 4 stars only because my account can only be accessed on one device.  I was planning to access it across both my iPad and iPhone depending on the size of screen I needed at the time.  Customer service took my feedback and I feel they will eventually make this possible.

reviews.title: Slop
reviews.text: AI AI AI AI

reviews.title: Content isn't worth the price
reviews.text: The videos are like 90 seconds long if that and don't go beyond surface level. This is more suitable for middle schoolers.

reviews.title: get rid of the questionnaire
reviews.text: I would love this if I didn’t have to constantly fill out a multi page questionnaire … good god. Just let me download the app and let me choose my learning. If I had the app with the selection of micro classes I could watch, I’d likely buy it! But, jeesus … it’s annoying af.

reviews.title: Good learning tool!
reviews.text: This app allows me to learn what I am interested in at a pace that allows me to retain the information! Not only that, but their product support is truly support! I had an issue with the app not recognizing my payment, and they fixed it quickly! I would recommend this app for anyone who wants some useful knowledge with the confidence of knowing they will fix any issues you might have!

reviews.title: Not true
reviews.text: The first lesson states that the jaw is the only bone in your body that moves on its own. Actually, the accurate version is “the mandible is the only moving bone in the skull,” not “the only moving bone in the body.” Details matter.

reviews.title: Gentle reminder
reviews.text: The tone of the app is like a gentle reminder or guide. Making it easy to digest!

reviews.title: DO NOT SUPPORT THIS GAME
reviews.text: This game company uses really harassing advertisements where people yell at each other for not getting small talk right. It’s horrible and honestly just putting more vile and dehumanizing and disgusting content out into the world. Please only support companies that have positive impacts on the world. It’s insane what some companies will sacrifice for money.

reviews.title: Pay to use
reviews.text: It is not clear in the App Store that this app is pay to use - I suppose I should have suspected that it was. Instead, I had to go through a bunch of questions and give my age range and learning style just to find out that I get a 7-day trial before I have to pay what I feel is an excessive amount. The app may be worth it for a learning app, however, had I known that I definitely would have to pay for it, I would never have downloaded it and this wasted my time.

reviews.title: I canceled the subscription and they still charged my account.
reviews.text: I Canceled my Subscription

reviews.title: Too Hard to Cancel
reviews.text: You are quick to sell your App, but slow to allow users to cancel.  I have been trying to cancel without luck. This is not fair.

reviews.title: Why pay?
reviews.text: Truly sucks I can’t use this app without paying as someone who’s young and wants to learn but has no way because I don’t have $$. Truly heartbroken

reviews.title: confusion.
reviews.text: how am i supposed to learn anything when i have to pay🤨

reviews.title: wasted my money
reviews.text: The app is terribly made with AI, they don’t use actual anatomically correct wording. I’ve learned anatomy, this is maybe ok for elementary. i completed all the “games” in 2 minutes.

reviews.title: It’s all ai slop
reviews.text: Sure, you are able to learn a few fun facts but you never actually learn what matters. Let alone the fact that the entirety of each lesson is just ai slop. I’d get it if they were just using ai for transcriptions but it’s literally used pretty heavily in every section of every lesson. It loses its appeal a lot, since it loses that human connection when teaching.

reviews.title: App isn’t really free
reviews.text: The app says it’s free but you need to pay like, $25 to unlock anything in the app

reviews.title: Gratitud
reviews.text: Excelente aplicación es una gran contribución al desarrollo de la cultura y pensamiento crítico

reviews.title: Superb Tech Support
reviews.text: MyGrowth employees go the extra mile in assisting their users.  Each employee exhibits patience & knowledge.  I look forward to their developing more programs!  Shar

reviews.title: This App is a Scam
reviews.text: I’d give this all a negative rating if I could.  Their Facebook ad offered the profit $9.99, but when I tried to use the app, I was directed to a page demanding an additional $24.99 for a monthly auto renewing subscription. Then, My Growth attempted to charge my credit card twice. And then, in their emails, they blamed me for not reading the user agreement and excused their attempts at theft as accidental.  I’m considering reporting this group to the consumer protection agency in my state for fraud and attempted larceny.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text:
They advertise on social media that this app teaches you about the body through visualizations and illustrations and other categories, but they only have a couple learning sessions with the visuals, the rest you just read which you can get online for FREE. 
It is not nearly worth the $25 a month you pay to just read information that you can get off the Internet or AI for free! This is the epitome of false advertising.

reviews.title: Not what I thought it would be
reviews.text: Very AI looking, very hard to see what you are paying for and not easy to cancel

reviews.title: Hard to unsubscribe
reviews.text: Nice idea. However, iOS app is designed to be very difficult to cancel. I had to search for a “How-to” just to do it through the app. Even though I downloaded it from the Apple Store, the cancel function is buried. Also the subscription never showed up in my iOS Settings and can’t be cancelled through there. They continued to charge me monthly, even though I thought I’d cancelled before the 7 day free trial was up. Currently going through Apple Card Support to get a refund. If it happens, I’ll be back to add to this review..

reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: I have tried to cancel this app several times. It keeps appearing on my credit card bill monthly!!  I want it gone, please!!

reviews.title: Cancellation issues-zero stars
reviews.text: I cancelled this app and it is still trying to charge my locked card. Also I can’t download any new apps because I refuse to pay the 24.99 for this cancelled app. It’s ridiculous

reviews.title: Multiple charges
reviews.text: Cancelled my subscription through the App Store and was still charged for renewal. MyGrowth refused a refund.

reviews.title: Frustration Resolved
reviews.text:
I was quite frustrated when I initially purchased this app because every time I tried to open a lesson, it wouldn’t let me in; rather, I would be sent back to the subscription page as though I had no subscription.  I contacted MyGrowth support, and they helped resolve the issue.

Now I’m enjoying the lessons while exercising my brain at the same time.
